governingDocuments.AGENTS.md: Repository owner standing branch and agent policy. The owner's current explicit instruction supersedes stale additive-only test cadence wording where necessary for the governed Orchestrator architecture.
governingDocuments.DEVLOG.md: Repository-visible chain of custody and current shared AI handoff.
governingDocuments.AI-CONFLICTS.json: Auditable AI conflict ledger; never bypass or disable it.
governingDocuments.src/handoffPolicy.js: Enforces takeover-ready handoff and DEVLOG chain of custody through validateHandoffPlan and validateDevlogChainOfCustody, including the bounded Command log archive requirements.
governingDocuments.src/testCadence.js: The governed Orchestrator entry point. It preserves all existing test selection authority while applying progress-heartbeat, known-bug persistence, and verified-resolution controls to production test invocations.
governingDocuments.src/testCadenceCore.js: The preserved Orchestrator selection core containing cadence, explicit Code/Security/Utility/Maintenance classification, natural-language request interpretation, change-impact selection, and fail-closed classification behavior.
governingDocuments.src/testRunGovernance.js: Orchestrator run governance for 60-second test progress updates, category-derived criticality, known-bug persistence, severity ordering, and mandatory passing re-tests before resolution.
governingDocuments.governingDocuments/known-bugs/README.md: Known-bug governance policy, criticality order, persistence behavior, progress-update cadence, and mandatory re-test lifecycle.
governingDocuments.governingDocuments/known-bugs/KNOWN-BUGS: Governed severity-sorted known-bug ledger. Resolved or checked entries are invalid unless their latest recorded re-test passed.

sessionPolicy.recheckGoverningDocuments: Re-read every file listed in governingDocuments at the start of every session and again any time more than 10 minutes have passed since lastActionAt, even if it is the same agent continuing the same conversation.

syntheticTestRequestCommitTransport.description: The CRUCIBLE TEST REQUEST synthetic commit-message transport exists only because the current ChatGPT/GitHub integration cannot directly create the required Orchestrator invocation. It is a workaround, not the intended architecture.
syntheticTestRequestCommitTransport.replacementRequirement: Replace and remove this workaround as soon as a supported direct integration or direct connection exists that can pass the user's natural-language test request to the Orchestrator without manufacturing a repository commit.
syntheticTestRequestCommitTransport.targetArchitecture: User test request -> supported direct integration/connection -> Orchestrator -> Orchestrator alone selects and runs tests -> results.
syntheticTestRequestCommitTransport.standingOwnerAuthorization: The owner explicitly authorizes the governed agent to perform this specific replacement as soon as the supported direct integration/connection capability exists. No additional owner approval is required solely to replace and remove the synthetic test-request transport.
syntheticTestRequestCommitTransport.scopeBoundary: This standing authorization applies only to replacing the temporary test-request transport with a genuine direct integration/connection. It does not authorize unrelated repository changes or promotion to main/release.
